title: Python requirement pinned to a prerelease
description: requirements.txt declares an exact pin to a PEP 440 prerelease build. Prerelease builds carry no stability promise and sit outside most advisory ranges, so a known defect can ship while the pin looks deliberate.
remediation: Pin the first stable release, and record the review that approved a prerelease.
limitation: It matches an exact pin to a PEP 440 prerelease build in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
